current_measure: Historical homelessness rate; rents; allocated-cohort housing waits
denominator: Homelessness per 10,000 people; rents per new letting; months per allocated household
trend_observed_or_missing: 2016→2021 rate rose; 2025 rent-index growth slower than prior year; no complete current unmet-need trend
outcome_to_test: Housing retained safely/affordably at 12 months; homelessness/eviction recurrence
required_disaggregation: Household type, income, Aboriginal status, disability, family violence, metropolitan/regional
interpretation_limit: Housing loss/health consequences need direct measures; do not sum unlike metrics

current_measure: Recorded family incidents in year to March 2026
denominator: Incidents per year, not unique people
trend_observed_or_missing: Down 3.4% in extracted window; June 2026 release pending extraction
outcome_to_test: Repeat victimisation, serious harm and survivor-defined safety
required_disaggregation: Age/sex, Aboriginal status, disability, region, repeat incidents
interpretation_limit: Reporting and police practice can change counts

denominator: Deaths by occurrence year; population-adjusted rates needed
trend_observed_or_missing: 2022–2025 counts vary; matched partial-2026 count lower
outcome_to_test: Suicide/self-harm and wellbeing plus unmet-care/wait outcomes
required_disaggregation: Age, sex, First Nations, region, deprivation; protect small cells
interpretation_limit: Distress and service access not fully operationalised by mortality

denominator: State area-averaged anomaly and rainfall percentage
trend_observed_or_missing: Annual 2025 anomaly is not a long-term trend; S08 provides longer-term context
required_disaggregation: Age, housing quality, outdoor work, region, socioeconomic status
interpretation_limit: Climate exposure is not measured avoidable human burden

denominator: Reported target performance; patient-level denominator not extracted
trend_observed_or_missing: Missed specified targets every year 2020–21 to 2024–25; other urgent targets met
outcome_to_test: Clinically harmful delay, outcomes, patient-reported access
interpretation_limit: A throughput target is not a causal harm measure

current_measure: Ran out of food and could not buy more
denominator: Adults responding to survey item; separate from national household scale
trend_observed_or_missing: Aboriginal 2023→2024 estimate higher; sampling error needs checking
outcome_to_test: Adequate food; household material deprivation, debt, safe indoor conditions
required_disaggregation: Aboriginal status, household type/income, region, disability
interpretation_limit: All essentials cannot be inferred from a food item; adult/household metrics differ

denominator: Deaths per year and per 100,000 residents; trip/km exposure pending
trend_observed_or_missing: 2025 count above ten-year average; below national rate
outcome_to_test: Deaths/serious injury per trip and per kilometre
required_disaggregation: Road-user type, geography, age, socioeconomic/occupation exposures
interpretation_limit: Serious injuries and changed travel volumes not captured

current_measure: Combined low-floor tram plus level-stop service
denominator: Share of tram services, not share of people or trips completed
outcome_to_test: Completed accessible trips and access to essential destinations
required_disaggregation: Disability type, age, geography, non-drivers and time of day
interpretation_limit: Bus frequency/span and regional access remain baseline gaps

current_measure: AEDC on track in all five domains
trend_observed_or_missing: 57.2% in 2021 to 53.8% in 2024; still above national
outcome_to_test: Child wellbeing/development and narrowed opportunity gaps
required_disaggregation: Deprivation, Aboriginal status, language, region; cultural validity
interpretation_limit: Observational cohort monitoring is not a diagnosis or proof of a cause

trend_observed_or_missing: Poor and deteriorating, high confidence; other indicators have varied confidence
outcome_to_test: Native habitat condition, persistence and threatened-species risk
required_disaggregation: Ecosystem/region, Traditional Owner priorities, land tenure
interpretation_limit: Mixed data years and methods; no avoided-extinction estimate

current_measure: Adult custody census and Aboriginal age-standardised rate
denominator: Stock at 30 June; subgroup rate per 100,000 Aboriginal adults
trend_observed_or_missing: Aboriginal stock up 26% and standardised rate up 2024→2025
outcome_to_test: Repeat victimisation, safe alternatives to avoidable custody, fairness
required_disaggregation: Aboriginal status, age, sex, sentenced/remand, location
interpretation_limit: Custody growth is not automatically policy failure; crime/rights counterfactual needed

denominator: Full child-level outcome denominator not extracted
trend_observed_or_missing: Target missed since 2021–22; no complete harm/safety series
outcome_to_test: Safety, repeat harm and culturally appropriate care
required_disaggregation: Aboriginal children; placement type, age, disability, region
interpretation_limit: Unranked until suitable baseline and Aboriginal-led framing are available
